title: Five Running
text: Accord, Mission Control. Five good reports in a row. That's exactly what we hoped for when we sent you.

lines.text: Whatever you're doing, don't stop. Everybody here is watching your numbers.

choices.label: "We won't stop."
choices.reply: The recording ends. The next report goes out at sol's end, a little higher.

choices.label: "Who is everybody?"
choices.reply: The recording doesn't answer. It was never going to. You file the question with the others.

notes: Five good home reports running (counter report-streak, src/sim/planet.ts). Paid off at the Foundry (director-three: ACCORD STREAK, TAKE 1).
